name: deploy_package
label: Package Information
description: The package information is used for related queries for package-related operations such as reporting.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Primary key, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: The engineering group identifier is typically unique within an organization or a project. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: artifact_id
fields.description: The engineering identifier typically consists of the project name, along with the groupId and artifactId, which define the artifact's location in the repository.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The package type is by default `jar`.

fields.name: url
fields.description: The URL for the package in the maven repository.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: uk_pkg
indexes.description: Unique index covering the group_id, artifact_id, version fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
